name: cytoscnpy
description: Python static analyzer with MCP server for GitHub Copilot. Real-time dead code detection, security scanning, and code quality metrics.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: CytoScnPy runs the executable named by `cytoscnpy.path`, which workspace settings can set, so it stays disabled until the workspace is trusted.

cytoscnpy.path.description: Path to the CytoScnPy executable. Leave empty to use bundled binary or pip-installed version.
cytoscnpy.path.markdownDescription:
Path to the CytoScnPy executable. Leave empty to use the bundled binary or the pip-installed version.

The extension runs this executable, so a value from workspace settings only takes effect in trusted workspaces.

enumDescriptions: Analyze entire workspace for accurate cross-file detection (recommended)
Analyze only the current file for faster feedback (may have false positives)
cytoscnpy.analysisMode.description: Analysis mode: 'workspace' for full project analysis, 'file' for single-file analysis.

cytoscnpy.enableSecretsScan.description: Scan for hardcoded secrets. When unset, project config (pyproject.toml/.cytoscnpy.toml) decides; an explicit false disables the scan even if project config enables it.

cytoscnpy.enableDangerScan.description: Scan for dangerous code patterns. When unset, project config decides; an explicit false disables the scan even if project config enables it.

cytoscnpy.enableQualityScan.description: Scan for code quality issues. When unset, project config or threshold settings can enable it; an explicit false disables quality analysis even if they do.

cytoscnpy.enableCloneScan.description: Detect duplicate/similar code blocks. When unset, project config decides; an explicit false disables clone detection even if project config enables it.

cytoscnpy.confidenceThreshold.description: Minimum confidence level (0-100) of findings to report. Set to 0 to show all findings.

cytoscnpy.includeFolders.description: Folders to force-include in analysis (overrides default exclusions).

cytoscnpy.includeTests.description: Include test files in analysis. When unset, project config decides; an explicit false excludes them even if project config includes them.

cytoscnpy.includeIpynb.description: Include Jupyter Notebooks (.ipynb files) in analysis. When unset, project config decides; an explicit false skips them even if project config includes them.

cytoscnpy.maxComplexity.description: Maximum allowed Cyclomatic Complexity before flagging.

cytoscnpy.maxNesting.description: Maximum allowed nesting depth before flagging.

cytoscnpy.maxArguments.description: Maximum allowed function arguments before flagging.

cytoscnpy.maxLines.description: Maximum allowed function lines before flagging.

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
